8 days | Tsavo, Amboseli, Lake Naivasha and Masai Mara

Package overview

One itinerary, not two. Tsavo East and West, Amboseli, a Naivasha pause, then the Mara. Two of the days are long drives, and we say so before you book.

Travellers who want the south, a lake day and the Mara in one road safari. Highlights: Tsavo East and West, Amboseli and Kilimanjaro, Naivasha and a full Mara day.

Route Nairobi → Tsavo East → Tsavo West → Amboseli → Naivasha → Masai Mara → Nairobi

If you would rather skip the two long road days, we replace Naivasha with a scheduled flight from Amboseli or Wilson into the Mara.

Day-by-day itinerary

01Day 1 | Nairobi to Tsavo East

About six hours to Tsavo East and an afternoon drive.

Accommodation: Tsavo East

02Day 2 | Tsavo East to Tsavo West

Morning near the Galana or Aruba area, then into Tsavo West. Shetani lava flow or Mzima Springs if the day allows.

Accommodation: Tsavo West

03Day 3 | Tsavo West to Amboseli

A shorter transfer and an afternoon drive under Kilimanjaro.

Accommodation: Amboseli

04Day 4 | Amboseli

Morning and afternoon on the elephant plains.

Accommodation: Amboseli

05Day 5 | Amboseli to Lake Naivasha

A long drive of about seven hours. The boat ride moves to the next morning if you arrive late.

Accommodation: Lake Naivasha

06Day 6 | Naivasha to the Mara

Morning boat, and Hell’s Gate if you want to walk or cycle. Afternoon drive of about five hours to the Mara.

Accommodation: Masai Mara

07Day 7 | Masai Mara

A full day in the reserve.

Accommodation: Masai Mara

08Day 8 | Masai Mara to Nairobi

Morning drive and the return to Nairobi or the airport.

Accommodation: Departure

Where you sleep

Budget is a permanent tent or a simple lodge. Mid-range is an en-suite lodge or tented camp. Luxury is a smaller camp and, where it helps, a flight between parks. The camp names are written on your quote.

What's included

  • Accommodation on the plan we send you
  • Meals noted in the day-by-day itinerary
  • A private 4x4 with a pop-up roof and an English-speaking guide
  • Park and conservancy fees for the places on the itinerary
  • Arrival and departure transfers in the city where the trip starts
  • Bottled drinking water in the vehicle

What's excluded

  • International flights
  • Visas, vaccinations and travel insurance
  • Gorilla and chimpanzee permits, unless your quote includes them
  • Tips, laundry, premium drinks and personal purchases
  • Balloon flights, extra activities and community visits
